steps.text: Talk to the Head Butler outside the at the entrance to Villa Lucens on the island of Aldarin.
Talk to Patzi at the entrance to Villa Lucens on the island of Aldarin to start the quest.
Enter the house north of Patzi through the window to steal a butler's uniform. If the Wandering Guard bothers you, wait until he steps away before entering.
Steal the butler's uniform from the wardrobe.
Leave the house with the butler's uniform.
Return to Patzi after stealing the butler's uniform.
Continue talking to Patzi
Equip the Butler's uniform pieces and talk to the Head Butler up the stone stairs and to the south.
Head inside the villa and talk to Patzi.
Introduce yourself to Constantinius.
Introduce yourself to Cozyac.
Introduce yourself to Pavo.
Introduce yourself to Xocotla.
Return to Patzi with the information you've gathered.
Enter the cellar.
Investigate the Antique wine in the southern part of the cellar.
Check on the man in the south-eastern part of the cellar.
Explain your innocence to the guards Stradius and Hutza.
Enter the cellar again to begin your investigation.
Investigate the Jug by the entrance stairs.
Investigate the Small box in the south room.
Investigate the Broken stool in the south room.
Investigate the Wine storage in the east room.
Investigate the Broken pottery in the east room.
Investigate Livius in the east room.
Leave the cellar.
Interrogate Constantinius.
Interrogate Cozyac.
Interrogate Pavo.
Interrogate Xocotla.
Interrogate Patzi and Adala.
Return to the guards with the information you've found so far.
choices: I think I've found everything there is to find so far. What now?

steps.text: Pickpocket Adala until you find Wine labels.
Pickpocket Cozyac until you find a threatening note.
Pickpocket Pavo until you find a drinking flask.
Pickpocket Xocotla until you find a shipping contract.
Inspect the Wine labels in your inventory.
Inspect the Threatening note in your inventory.
Inspect the Drinking flask in your inventory.
Inspect the Shipping contract in your inventory.
Return to the guards with the stolen items.
choices: I think I've found everything there is to find so far. What now?

steps.text: Talk to the guards to tell them you're ready to make an accusation.
Interrogate Constantinius.
Interrogate Xocotla.
Interrogate Cozyac.
Interrogate Pavo.
Accuse Adala of the crime, ready for a fight you cannot lose.
Fight Adala. You cannot lose this fight.
Talk to Adala to get her confession.
Talk to the guards about Adala.
Climb down the staircase.
Climb down the staircase.
Climb the Loose rocks south-east of the villa on your way to the theatre.
Climb down the loose rocks in your way to the guards outside the theatre.
Talk to Stradius at the backstage of the theatre.
Enter the theatre through the backstage entrance.
Talk to the Costumer in the theatre cellar.
Search the crate next to the stairs.
Search the bookshelf on the west wall.
Search the costume rack to the north.
Talk to the Costumer about what you found.
Climb up the stairs of the theatre cellar.
Report back to Stradius near the theatre and accuse Naiatli.
Talk to Stradius to enter the theatre.
Confront Naiatli, attacking her when she runs away. When Clodius appears, attack him instead.
Attack Clodius.
Kill Naiatli.
Talk to Naiatli.
Talk to Stradius and Hutza to finish the quest.
